devdoc.details: Upgradeable; owned by the team. Configures beacons, deploys proxies for contract types,      and exposes discovery helpers used by peer contracts (Bank, Investor, etc.).

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

Officer__BeaconNotConfigured(string).details: No beacon is configured for this contract type.

Officer__BodMustBeDeployedViaElections().details: BoardOfDirectors must be deployed through Elections.

Officer__DuplicateBeaconType(string).details: Duplicate beacon types are not allowed.

Officer__NotOwnerOrInitializing().details: The caller is neither the contract owner nor is initialization in progress.

Officer__Unauthorized().details: The caller is not authorized for this action.

Officer__ZeroAddress().details: A required address argument was the zero address.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

params.deployments: Array of deployment data containing contract types and initializer data

returns._0: deployedAddresses Array of deployed proxy addresses

params.contractType: The type of contract to find

returns._0: The address of the contract, or address(0) if not found
The address of the Board of Directors contract
The beacon address, or address(0) if none is configured
Array of deployed contract information (type and address)
The address of the fee collector contract
Array of founder addresses and array of member addresses

params.beaconConfigs: Array of beacon configurations to initialize.
params.deployments: Deployment descriptors run when `isDeployAllContracts` is true.
params.isDeployAllContracts: When true, immediately deploys all described proxies.

params.tokenAddress: The address of the token to check

returns._0: True if the token is supported, false otherwise

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

__gap.details: Storage gap reserving 50 slots for future upgrades. Decrement when adding      new state variables above so the reserve stays constant and proxy slots don't shift.
